_comment: Cards that exist only for the total-power test (tests/unit/targets/test_total_power.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_reunion` is Reunion of the House's first sentence: a cap on the picks' power TOGETHER. `t_each_ten` is the counterfactual -- the same line read as a cap on each of them, which is what a selector clause can say and is a much wider card.

cards.name: Test Reunion
cards.oracle_text: Return any number of target creature cards with total power 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Test Each Ten
cards.oracle_text: Return any number of target creature cards with power 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
